football_evidence.question: Can Utah State take away Texas State’s big plays?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward Texas State, and its own breakdown accounts for about 0.3 of the 3.0 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.
supporting: When Texas State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Texas State’s offense has allowed a sack on 3.5% of its dropbacks, and Utah State’s defense sacks the quarterback on 5.7% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Texas State has the ball (third down): Texas State’s offense converts 56.6% of its third downs, and Utah State’s defense allows opponents to convert 40.1% of their third downs (FBS average 39.7%).

When Utah State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Utah State’s offense has allowed a sack on 9.4% of its dropbacks, and Texas State’s defense sacks the quarterback on 4.0% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Utah State has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Utah State’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 20.8% of its runs, and Texas State’s defense stops 25.1% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
contradicting: EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Utah State’s secondary No. 9 nationally and Texas State’s No. 68.

When Texas State has the ball (the red zone): Texas State’s offense succeeds on 47.8% of its red-zone plays, and Utah State’s defense allows success on 37.7% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).
quarterbacks: Brad Jackson has completed 106 of 157 passes (67.5%) for 1,439 yards, 9.2 yards per attempt, 14 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in six games for Texas State, and has been sacked on 4 of 161 dropbacks.

Grady Brosterhous has completed 79 of 146 passes (54.1%) for 913 yards, 6.3 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 6 interceptions in six games for Utah State, and has been sacked on 16 of 162 dropbacks.
McCae Hillstead has completed 17 of 38 passes (44.7%) for 225 yards, 5.9 yards per attempt, 2 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in two games for Utah State, and has been sacked on 3 of 41 dropbacks.
